about.title: About the project
about.lead: AI Resume Review helps candidates quickly understand how ready their resume is for a vacancy and what to improve before applying.
about.hire: I am an experienced developer available for product, interface, internal tool, and system development where clear architecture, code quality, and thoughtful execution matter.
about.note: The project makes job searching clearer: less manual checking and more insight into resume strengths and weaknesses. If you need an experienced developer for interfaces, products, or engineering solutions, I would be glad to discuss the opportunity.

analysis.title: Resume analysis
analysis.description: Check structure, contact details, text length, sections, and vacancy-specific keywords.

comparison.title: Vacancy comparison
comparison.description: Highlight skill matches and identify where the experience description needs improvement.

coverLetter.title: Cover letter generation
coverLetter.description: Quickly prepare a cover letter based on your target role and vacancy.

local.title: Local processing
local.description: Keep data in the browser for a private and transparent workflow.

history.title: Analysis history

history.clearDescription: The analysis history will be permanently deleted.
history.removeDescription: The analysis will be permanently deleted from history.

correctedResume.title: Corrected resume
correctedResume.subtitle: Review the result, make final edits, and download the document.
correctedResume.missingAdviceDescription: The corrected version is generated from the analysis recommendations.
correctedResume.emptyDescription: Facts and experience will stay unchanged while structure and wording improve.

coverLetter.title: Cover letter
coverLetter.subtitle: Generate a letter from the current role, vacancy, and resume analysis.
coverLetter.historyEmptyDescription: Generated letters and vacancy settings will be saved here.
